name: @rock3r/atc
description: Daemonless Agent Traffic Control for Android emulators, iOS Simulators, physical devices, and Gradle/Bazel/Xcode builds — leases, co-scheduling, bounded-window warm-affinity wait queue, snapshots, crash recovery, and multi-agent guardrails.
author: Sebastiano Poggi <me@sebastiano.dev>

scripts.check: node -e "import('node:fs').then(async({readdirSync})=>{const{spawnSync}=await import('node:child_process');for(const d of['bin','src','scripts','test'])for(const f of readdirSync(d))if(f.endsWith('.mjs')){const r=spawnSync(process.execPath,['--check',d+'/'+f],{stdio:'inherit'});if(r.status!==0)process.exit(r.status)}})" && node --test --test-concurrency=1
